        (set_op.expression, scope),

            left_scope = operand_scopes.pop()

[None->sqlite] WITH a AS (SELECT 1) (SELECT 1 FROM a UNION SELECT 2) INTERSECT SELECT 3
    => WITH a AS (SELECT 1) SELECT 1 FROM a UNION SELECT 2 INTERSECT SELECT 3
